newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT to make ally decision in mid-April.
newsitem.headline: PT to make ally decision in mid-April.

text.p: State-controlled Portugal Telecom will make an announcement on any future strategic alliance in mid-April and not at a shareholders' meeting later today, a government spokesman said.

The spokesman was commenting on a report in the daily Publico which said that the Espirito Santo banking group was trying to assemble a core shareholder group to take a controlling 31 percent stake in Telecom during the third phase of the company's privatisation.
The paper said that Portugal Telecom would make an announcement on its choice of a strategic ally at its Annual General Meeting which starts at 1400 GMT.
The Planning Ministry spokesman said that Telecom was still discussing its strategic alliance.
Four consortia have shown an interest in forming an alliance with Telecom. Analysts say Concert, a venture between British Telecom and the U.S. MCI Communications Corp, may be the front runner.
In addition the Franco-German venture Global One and Unisource, which includes AT&T, Dutch, Swedish and Swiss groups, are interested.

The spokesman said that today's meeting would approve the creation of a special reserve which would allow employees to buy up to 100,000 escudos of shares each during the third phase of privatisation.
The government plans to sell off 26 percent of the company in the second half of this year, leaving it with a "golden share" of 25 percent.
